page.overview:
Who is Parish Nandermane?

Parish Nandermane is a male background Earth pony who appears in several episodes, Gameloft's mobile game, and the IDW comics. He has an indigo coat, bright blue mane and tail, green eyes, and a cutie mark of a lyre. He is not named in the series, but he is named in other media.__TOC__

Parish Nandermane shares his tail style, cutie mark, and stool design with "Kazooie", his cutie mark with Lyrica Lilac, "Majesty", "Reflective Rock", and sometimes "Bottlecap", and his cutie mark design with Lyra Heartstrings, "Bee Bop", "Ballad", "Heather Harp", and sometimes S01E21 Unnamed Earth Stallion #10.

Parish appears briefly in Sweet and Elite at the Canterlot Garden Party, playing with Octavia, Wolfgang Canter, and Symphony Song.

He reappears in Inspiration Manifestation, switched from S04E16 Unnamed Earth Stallion #3 by a cursed Rarity during a foal's birthday party. In the episode Equestria Games, Parish is partly seen in the stadium crowd as Spike attempts to light the Games torch.
